P11.3a: Coalition lifecycle + CLI (steer surface, manual collab). Code lands in ~/workspace/flywheel (bead tracker stays in toron). Cargo slot acquired.

SLICE:
- NEW flywheel/src/coalition.rs: CoalitionManifest (state_dir()/coalitions/<id>.json, XDG_STATE_HOME-overridable) + CoalitionStore (durable mailbox via TORON_DATA_DIR like mail_shim, shared tokio runtime). NIP-29 channel: kind-40/41 create+metadata + kind-42 board posts published to the mailbox bus (operator-signed, project-scoped witness); coalition = channel + goal workflow run (engine invoke, recording runner, run_id logged to run_log) + manifest.
- main.rs CoalitionCmd: form/status/intent/reserve/negotiate{request,respond,status,escalate}/list/disband. Goal = workflow name (lint gate engine-tier, mirrors workflow run). Members = squad profile names (profile::Squad::from_recipe). All ops membership-gated (--as must be a member).
- Manual collab: intent declare -> P11.2 declare_intent; reserve -> P11.2 file_reservation_paths (soft-conflict FREEZE visible in output); negotiate -> P11.2 request_release/respond/status/escalate. NO auto-proposer (P11.3b).
- Disband: explicit + optional --beads-closed gate (verifies listed beads closed via br subprocess, best-effort); releases member-held reservations; closes channel (kind-42 post + manifest closed).
- toron-core ONE-LINE widen: active_reservations pub(crate)->pub (P11.3a status consumer; ADR-0011 Context zone).

GATES: form creates channel + starts run; intent visible in status; second-crew acquire = soft-conflict freeze; request-release resolves manually; disband closes.

TESTS (TDD): tests/coalition_lifecycle.rs — form->status (channel event on bus, run_id), intent declare visible, freeze on overlap acquire, negotiate roundtrip, disband releases + closes. Temp XDG_STATE_HOME + TORON_DATA_DIR per test.
